headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Jamie Hayter vs. Hikaru Shida fought tooth and nail for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.12 ? an outstanding performance from both sides. Hayter and Shida delivered what many called the best AEW Women's World Championship match to date, with Hayter's ripcord lariat retaining the title after Shida kicked out of everything thrown at her.
